name: 05-tracker-payload-live
description: LIVE tracker scenario. Calls the real Jira/GitHub tracker via the platform resolver, asserts a created issue exists, then cleans up. Requires JIRA_URL/JIRA_TOKEN or GH_TOKEN. Skipped (clean exit) by the runner whenever the driver's isAvailable() returns false — replay driver cannot satisfy this scenario; intended for DRIVER=claude-sdk on a workflow_dispatch CI run, NOT for local hermetic CI.
prompt: Create a task for cache lib eval — issue should land in the configured tracker. Architectural source: docs/architecture/tech-stack.md#caching.
